one_line: OpenAI and Apple spar in court, small language models advance, and AI agents drive infrastructure shifts.

themes.title: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets
themes.text: OpenAI filed a countersuit against Apple in a California court, accusing the iPhone maker of stealing trade secrets and coercing shared suppliers amid an ongoing dispute over employees and hardware development.

stories.headline: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets and supplier threats

themes.title: Small language models match large counterparts
themes.text: Small language models emerged as efficient alternatives to large language models, offering task-specific optimisation, running on local devices, and requiring significantly less computation while matching or exceeding larger models.

stories.headline: Small language models rival large models in 2026 with lower compute costs

themes.title: AI agents force infrastructure rethink
themes.text: The rise of autonomous personal AI agents capable of shopping and payments is forcing ecommerce platforms, banks, and payment companies to rethink digital infrastructure access and customer relationships.

stories.headline: Rise of personal AI agents prompts businesses to rethink infrastructure access
